title: RASGEF1B suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma through the ALDH7A1/Betaine/SNAI1 metabolic‒epigenetic axis.
authors: Guo, Zeyi; Tan, Kunjiang; Li, Zhongzhe; Ren, Yaguang; Dai, Yizhe; Jin, Meixian; Fu, Yu; Hu, Yukai; Guo, Jinhao; Zhang, Min; Liu, Chengbo; Fu, Shunjun; Shen, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RASGEF1B通过代谢-表观遗传轴抑制肝癌，涉及SNAI1 DNA甲基化，但核心是肿瘤代谢与表观调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Metabolic‒epigenetic crosstalk critically orchestrates hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) pathogenesis. Deciphering the precise mechanism underlying epigenetic remodeling and metabolic reprogramming in HCC may lead to novel treatment paradigms, however, the key mechanisms remain elusive. METHODS: RT-qPCR, western blotting and tissue microarrary Immunohistochemistry were used to detect the expression of RasGEF domain family member 1B (RASGEF1B) in HCC and normal liver tissues. Transcriptome sequencing and high-resolution untargeted metabolomics were integrated to identify the downstream regulatory mechanism through which RASGEF1B inhibited the HCC progression. Epigenetic regulation was investigated using methylation-specific PCR and luciferase reporter assays. Bioinformatic prediction and molecular docking suggested a functional interplay among RASGEF1B, ALDH7A1, and BMI1, which was experimentally confirmed through coimmunoprecipitation, GST pull-down, and immunofluorescence assays. Protein stability and ubiquitination status of ALDH7A1 were examined using cycloheximide, immunoprecipitation assay, and an in vitro reconstituted ubiquitination system. RESULTS: In this study, the antitumor role of RASGEF1B was confirmed in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptomic profiling revealed that RASGEF1B overexpression significantly reduced the snail family transcriptional repressor 1 (SNAI1), a master regulator of the epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Untargeted metabolomics revealed that RASGEF1B promoted SNAI1 DNA methylation through Betaine-mediated methionine metabolic reprogramming. Further analysis confirmed that RASGEF1B competitively protected the ALDH7A1 protein from BMI1-dependent ubiquitination, thereby elevating cellular Betaine levels in HCC. CONCLUSIONS: This study revealed that RASGEF1B inhibited SNAI1 to suppress HCC through metabolite‒epigenetic crosstalk. Our findings potentially offer a new perspective on the classical RAS signaling framework, uncovering a metabolic‒epigenetic axis as an innovative therapeutic approach for improving clinical outcomes in patients with HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢-表观遗传串扰在肝细胞癌（HCC）发病机制中起关键调控作用。阐明HCC中表观遗传重塑和代谢重编程的精确机制可能带来新的治疗范式，然而，关键机制仍不明确。方法：采用RT-qPCR、western blotting和组织微阵列免疫组化检测RasGEF结构域家族成员1B（RASGEF1B）在HCC及正常肝组织中的表达。整合转录组测序和高分辨率非靶向代谢组学，以识别RASGEF1B抑制HCC进展的下游调控机制。通过甲基化特异性PCR和荧光素酶报告基因实验研究表观遗传调控。生物信息学预测和分子对接提示RASGEF1B、ALDH7A1和BMI1之间存在功能性相互作用，并通过免疫共沉淀、GST pull-down和免疫荧光实验予以证实。使用放线菌酮、免疫沉淀实验和体外重建泛素化系统检测ALDH7A1的蛋白稳定性和泛素化状态。结果：在本研究中，RASGEF1B的抗肿瘤作用在体外和体内均得到证实。转录组分析显示，RASGEF1B过表达显著降低了snail家族转录抑制因子1（SNAI1），后者是上皮-间质转化的关键调控因子。非靶向代谢组学揭示，RASGEF1B通过甜菜碱介导的甲硫氨酸代谢重编程促进SNAI1 DNA甲基化。进一步分析确认，RASGEF1B竞争性保护ALDH7A1蛋白免受BMI1依赖性泛素化，从而提升HCC中细胞甜菜碱水平。结论：本研究揭示RASGEF1B通过代谢-表观遗传串扰抑制SNAI1从而抑制HCC。我们的发现可能为经典RAS信号框架提供新视角，揭示代谢-表观遗传轴作为改善HCC患者临床预后的创新治疗途径。
